name: Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel de Paris et d'Ile-de-France
summary: Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel de Paris et d'Ile-de-France provides various banking services in France, Other European Union countries, North America, South Africa, the Middle East, Asia and Oceania, and Japan. The company offers saving accounts, investment services, real estate, housing and consumer loans, and payment services. It also provides property, casualty, and life insurance. In addition, it offers leasing, factoring, and sale of new real estate. The company serves individuals, farmers, professionals, businesses, and local authorities.
